title: Virtual Card Management: Creating One-Time Use Cards for Security
summary: Explains how to create and use one-time (single-use) virtual cards in the Virtual Card Management feature, including the requirement that one-time use cards be enabled and the Cards > Virtual > Create new card workflow. Notes that after one successful authorization the card can’t be reused; failed transactions require generating a new card, and card details shouldn’t be saved or shared beyond the intended payee.
